text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I visited the 'Shundai Festival'—an Umamusume celebration—
along with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I did a test run, and neither the target placement nor the track conditions seem to be an issue. The Yabusame team prepared thoroughly as well.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much, President!!
To think you would personally check it for me...!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, President.
Could you also instruct this year's archer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
It might be presumptuous to call it passing down the mantle, but offering guidance is the privilege of those with experience, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Symboli Rudolf spent the entire day running around to support the Shundai Festival—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President. Thank you for your hard work with the closing remarks as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Air Groove.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The ritual has concluded without issue.
Please enjoy yourselves for as long as time permits.
Everyone needs to catch their breath now and then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ? What do you mean by...?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Good work today, Madam President!
The food stalls are extending their hours!
choice_data_list: Pretty sure we still haven't checked out the stalls, huh?
Pretty sure we still haven't checked out the stalls, have we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
! You guys... honestly.
Going out of your way to set things up with the food stalls, too...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brushing this off would truly be the hardest of hardships,
so I suppose I should quietly enjoy myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Attendant
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Nice arm, President~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you very much.
I do have some prior experience with shooting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes. My grandfather once took me on a trip to America. I picked up a bit of it there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Yet the talent of the girl speaking these words didn't end there.

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor
text_block_list.text:
T-To think you'd clear an SSS-rank difficulty die-cut candy...!
What incredible dexterity...!

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Vendor
text_block_list.text: Yes, we're offering a cotton candy making experience for 100 yen this time... wait, President, you're really good at making that...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you very much.
It felt similar to some crafts I've dabbled in before,
so my body just seemed to adapt naturally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...? What's the matter, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: You can do anything, can't you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wouldn't say 'anything', but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, but yes, you are right.
Passing down knowledge and experience is vital.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Say, Trainer. I'm usually the one asking
to learn from you, but...
Would you mind if I taught you a lesson tonight?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Today's event itself was completely unplanned.
Since we have this chance, why shouldn't you and I step into roles different from our usual ones?
choice_data_list: Then give me some tips on the shooting gallery!
I might want to try making artistic cotton candy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, shall we head back to the shop from earlier, then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Trainer-kun.
Which prize do you have your sights on?
choice_data_list: (If I had to choose from among these...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Prompted by Symboli Rudolf, I pointed to a prize that caught my eye on the very top shelf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then let's start by
checking your skill. Now, take aim—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, incorrect.
So close~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No matter, we still have bullets left.
Next time, let's keep the trajectory in mind and account for any drift.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Symboli Rudolf's advice, I rested my elbows on the shooting stall counter to steady my aim.
Making sure not to miss next time—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At that moment, something brushed softly against my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, my apologies. I was too close.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, however. It is difficult to give advice without truly standing at your eye level, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Your aim isn't bad. A little more to the lower right... that's it. Now, try once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf whispers softly in my ear.
Following her instruction, I tilt the muzzle down and to the right—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Trainer-kun.
You brought it down in magnificent fashion, didn't you?
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to what you taught me!
It's all thanks to what you taught me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd be so pleased.
Even if only for one night, there's no greater reward for an instructor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's gaze back then
felt somehow warmer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Artistic, you say? Fufu,
then I must rouse my spirits and guide them with all my might."

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Madam President. You've come again!
Care to try making cotton candy one more time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. This time Trainer-kun shall attempt it.
Now, Trainer-kun. Take these chopsticks and—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Try tilting it up a little more.
Wind the cotton around... That's it, now move it down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I twirl the chopsticks, trying to gather
the cotton candy floating fluffily inside the machine.
However, it doesn't turn out like the one she made...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, I'm going to touch you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Rudolf's hand overlapped with mine
as I held the disposable chopsticks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, probably at this angle.
Here, try turning it just like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next, tilt it upwards... Yes,
that way it'll naturally take on a beautiful shape—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...See? All done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I pull the chopstick out of the cotton candy machine,
there's a fluffy, massive cotton candy that I can hardly believe I made myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do it one more time while your body still remembers.
Would you mind making one for me this time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, this time I made a giant cotton candy for Symboli Rudolf.
